name: Anokha Cubing Royale 2018
information:
There will be a passport to be collected as part of the college fest, on the day of the event. The cost for the passport is INR 300/- and includes all the competition fees. Please carry your original school/college/other ID proof to collect the passport. Additional information will be provided in the tabs
Note : School students need not get Anokha Passport.
